description: Canonical thesis campaign configuration — Antonio Jiménez Godínez, ISIA UMA (anteproyecto May 2024). Matches the campaign recorded in turn_battle_results/VERIFICATION_REPORT.md.
thesis_title_en: Adaptation and Integration of MARL Algorithms in a Turn-Based Multiagent Combat Environment Using OpenSpiel
_comment_num_turns: Shared by every algorithm in training and evaluation. Deep CFR traversals cost ~42 min/iteration at num_turns=10 (~9 days/seed); capping only Deep CFR was rejected because it would train on a smaller game than it is evaluated on.
_comment_dcfr_max_turns: 0 means 'use num_turns', i.e. no separate Deep CFR horizon.
